cards.mood: The piece establishes a solemn, mythic atmosphere from the outset, maintaining a consistent weight of gravity and introspection throughout.
cards.palette: A low-frequency synthesizer drone serves as the foundational harmonic bed, present continuously from the Intro to the Outro, providing a constant, vibrating floor for the narration.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Beneath the weight of ancient stone,
Where the roots of time entwine,
Shadows stretch across the hollow ground,
And the stars begin their slow design.
[Chorus]
Fate is a river carved in ice,
Binding the soul to the earth,
A crown of dust for the weary king,
In the cradle of constant rebirth.
[Verse]
Mountains hold the secrets of the old,
Whispered in a language of gray,
The wind carries ghosts of empires lost,
As the golden light begins to fray.
[Chorus]
Fate is a river carved in ice,
Binding the soul to the earth,
A crown of dust for the weary king,
In the cradle of constant rebirth.
[Bridge]
The stars are eyes that never blink,
The earth is a heart that beats in stone.
[Chorus]
Fate is a river carved in ice,
Binding the soul to the earth,
A crown of dust for the weary king,
In the cradle of constant rebirth.
[Outro]
